svg.title: Valley Floor cap and merino sock set
svg.text: Perforated 5-panel cap and merino crew socks. One number, nothing else: the elevation you start from.
FRONT PANEL BLANK. UNDER-BRIM MOUNTAIN NAVY. NO HARDWARE.
CUFF KNIT-IN, NOT PRINTED. ONE SAGE ARCH BAND. LEFT AND RIGHT ARE THE SAME SOCK.
4,219 is the elevation of the valley
is the number the brand already
prints in its eyebrow line. Here it
is tonal, 0.55 in high, and the only
thing on the cap. Every run, ride
The bound brim edge is the only
a bright line at 5 a.m. on Wasatch
Cap and two pairs in a printed
Cap: made for VSL 5-panel running cap, 2.4 in soft brim, elastic back, 2 oz. Sock: made for VSL 7 in crew, true-to-foot sizing S/M/L.
Cap: 100% recycled polyester 4-way stretch ripstop, 85 gsm, PFAS-free DWR; side panels laser-perforated 1.2 mm / 4 mm pitch. Sock: 58%
merino (18.5 micron) / 39% nylon / 3% elastane, 200-needle, cushioned sole.
Cap: tonal flat embroidery, 0.55 in high, side panel, 1 color Sand on Cream. Sock: jacquard knit-in numeral at cuff, 0.75 in; one 0.4 in
Sage arch band. Salt-crystal line icon on the woven sweatband label only.
3M Scotchlite reflective bound brim edge, Coolmax sweatband, no eyelets, no buckle. Sock: Y-heel gore, hand-linked toe, left/right
Cap Cream #F6F1EC with Mountain Navy #13375D under-brim · Sock Mountain Navy with Cream cuff and Sage #8DCEA8 band. Second run: Forest
